findings.title: Foreign-thread context exit closes the live owner session
findings.trigger: Owner enters store.locked(); another thread calls that same manager.__exit__(None,None,None).
findings.observed: Accepted exit sets session inactive, closes same-process descriptors and releases owner root lock.
findings.required: Refuse foreign-thread teardown before advancement or descriptor closure; preserve owner use and eventual normal owner cleanup. Adding only a raise in a generator finally can lose owner cleanup and is insufficient.
